besluite.fout: 'sou' is a past-future that clashes with the present-tense narration
besluite.rede: In a story told in the present, 'sal' matches the tense and keeps the meaning that the door stays shut all week.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'die geld ... lê' and 'daar is' each have their own subject and verb, so the comma before 'en' is required.

besluite.fout: repeated 'hy' after 'en' reads stiffly under the shared time opener
besluite.rede: Inversion lets 'Teen die tweede pouse' govern both verbs, which is the natural written form, with no change in who does what.
The original order reads naturally in the story; the proposal is a lateral reordering.

besluite.fout: 'in twee stukke breek' loosens the fixed expression and sits awkwardly before 'helfte'
besluite.rede: 'In twee breek' is the idiomatic Afrikaans and says exactly the same thing.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'Dit is' and 'Thabang se honger is' are separate clauses; the protected 'brood met kaas' is untouched.

besluite.fout: 'sy bord vol eet' is not idiomatic, and the AWS clause comma is missing
besluite.rede: 'n Bord vol eet' is the natural expression for eating a plateful, the meaning is unchanged, and the comma is required.
The original already makes clear the food is cool against the ice; moving the phrase only makes it read differently.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'Hy eet' and 'dit smaak' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'die son bak' and 'Thabang se keel word' are separate clauses with their own subjects and verbs.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'Thabang drink' and 'die water is' are separate clauses with their own subjects and verbs.

besluite.fout: a chain of 'en' in a list reads clumsily
besluite.rede: Commas between the list items with one final 'en' is the normal form, and every item stays.
'Gaan staan' carries his walking up to the shelf and repeats the story's own motif; plain 'staan' loses that movement.

besluite.fout: a chain of 'en' between three actions reads clumsily
besluite.rede: A comma and one final 'en' keeps the same three actions in the same order and reads more smoothly.
'Vir die eerste keer' is the idiom for 'for the first time', which is exactly what the sentence means.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'Hy sê' and 'sy glimlag' each have their own subject and verb.
'Weg van ... af' is natural Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral reordering.
